agent_not_found.remedy: Check the address with host.agent.lookup, then re-send to a handle that exists.

alert_body_too_large.remedy: Shorten the alert body to data.limit_bytes or less and re-send.

anchor_not_found.remedy: Pick one of data.did_you_mean, or call host.help.search for a real anchor.

archive_corrupt.remedy: Re-run host.export and import the fresh archive; this one is damaged or not an export.

args_invalid.remedy: Re-send with data.field as data.expected; data.example shows a valid value.

args_schema_not_inferable.remedy: Declare args_schema explicitly in the spec; the source's argument use cannot be inferred.

ask_answered.remedy: Read the recorded answer in the response body; the first answer wins and cannot be changed.

ask_expired.remedy: Do not act on a missing answer; create a new ask with host.ask.create.

ask_not_found.remedy: List asks with host.ask.list and use an id from data.next_call's result.

asks_limit.remedy: Wait for a pending ask to be answered or expire, or reuse one from host.ask.list; data.asks_open_max is the ceiling.

auth_conflict.remedy: Send exactly one credential: either the URL secret or the Authorization header, not two different tenants.

authorization_required.remedy: Authorize through the OAuth metadata named in the WWW-Authenticate header, then retry with the token.

banned.remedy: This key is banned; do not retry. Contact support through the support_url on /support.html.

bearer_invalid.remedy: Call signup for a key, then send Authorization: Bearer <key> or pass tenant_key as an argument.

billing_unavailable.remedy: Billing is not configured on this host; do not retry. Read billing.plans for what the host offers.

blob_expired.remedy: Revive it with host.blob.touch {id, ttl_s} before the nightly prune, or upload the blob again.

blob_not_found.remedy: List blobs with host.blob.list and use an id or name that exists for this tenant.

blob_too_large.remedy: The blob is larger than blob_max_bytes (data.limit); upload a smaller file or move to a plan with a larger blob_max_bytes.

blob_too_large_inline.remedy: Fetch the blob through the link from host.blob.url instead of reading it inline.

budget_ceiling_exceeded.remedy: Lower the requested budget value to data.ceiling or below, or move to a plan with a higher ceiling.

budget_exceeded.remedy: Raise the run budget on data.dimension within the plan ceiling, or reduce the work per call.

build_failed.remedy: Read data.tail for the build error, fix the requirements in the spec, and republish.

call_timeout.remedy: Reduce the work per call or raise timeout_s within the plan ceiling, then retry.

capability_unsupported.remedy: Do not retry; use data.alternative when present or read /capabilities.json for implemented primitives.

capacity.remedy: Retry after data.retry_after_ms; the host is at its concurrent-call limit.

channel_closed.remedy: Posting is refused on a closed channel; reads still work. Open a new channel to continue.

channel_frozen.remedy: Posting is refused on a frozen channel; reads still work. Ask the owner to unfreeze it.

channel_not_found.remedy: Check data.key against host.channel.list and use a channel id or name that exists.

channel_unavailable.remedy: This call context has no channel backend; call the tool directly instead of from a sandbox.

chart_invalid_mark.remedy: Re-send with one of data.allowed as the mark.

choice_invalid.remedy: Choose one of the ask's listed options and answer again.

claim_email_failed.remedy: The claim email could not be sent; retry later or use the claim link from the response.

client_not_found.remedy: Check data.client_id against the pending clients list and use one that exists.

compose_children_exceeded.remedy: Reduce the number of child calls in the compose spec to the plan ceiling.

compose_depth_exceeded.remedy: Flatten the compose spec; nesting is deeper than the allowed depth.

compose_fanout_exceeded.remedy: Reduce the for_each fan-out to the allowed number of items.

compose_fanout_item_failed.remedy: Read data for the failing item's own error and fix or skip that item.

compose_input_missing.remedy: Pass the input the compose mapping reads, named in the message.

compose_item_outside_for_each.remedy: Use item only inside a for_each mapping.

compose_mapping_missing.remedy: Add the missing mapping for the child argument named in the message.

compose_mapping_type.remedy: Map a value of the child argument's declared type.

compose_mapping_unresolved.remedy: Fix the mapping path named in data.field so it resolves against the inputs.

compose_self_call.remedy: A compose tool may not call itself; point the step at a different tool.

concurrency_exceeded.remedy: Wait for in-flight calls to finish and retry; data.plan names the concurrency ceiling.

confirm_invalid.remedy: Call the dry run again and repeat with the freshly returned confirm token.

confirm_required.remedy: Call dry_run_first.tool with dry_run_first.args, read would, then repeat with the returned confirm token.

conflicting_credentials.remedy: Send one credential: drop the tenant_key argument or the Authorization header.

contact_pending.remedy: A request is already pending or recently denied; wait for the recipient to answer.

contact_refused.remedy: Send host.agent.contact_request first and wait for acceptance.

contact_request_not_found.remedy: List pending requests and use an id that exists.

cursor_invalid.remedy: omit cursor to restart from the first page

dead_letter_not_found.remedy: List dead letters and use an id that exists for this tenant.

dependency_advisory.remedy: Pin the package to data.fixed or later and republish.

dependency_policy.remedy: Remove or replace the requirement named in data.reason; the policy denies it.

dependency_resolve_failed.remedy: Read data.tail for the resolver error and fix the requirements.

docs_mime_unsupported.remedy: Use one of data.allowed mimes; binary files go to host.blob.put.

docs_not_found.remedy: List documents with host.docs.list and use a name or id that exists.

docs_provider_error.remedy: The embeddings provider returned an error status; retry later or check the provider config.

docs_provider_unreachable.remedy: The embeddings provider could not be reached; retry later or check its URL.

docs_secret_missing.remedy: Set the secret named in data.secret with host.secret_set, then retry.

docs_too_large.remedy: Shorten the document to data.limit_bytes or split it.

docs_unavailable.remedy: This call context has no document backend; call the tool directly instead of from a sandbox.

draft_test_failed.remedy: Read data for the failing draft test and adjust the request.

draft_unavailable.remedy: This host has no draft model configured; build the spec by hand from host.quickstart.

drift_review_not_found.remedy: List reviews with host.drift.list and use an item id that exists.

drift_target_not_found.remedy: Declare the table or document first, or use a target that already exists.

drift_unavailable.remedy: This call context has no drift backend; call the tool directly instead of from a sandbox.

egress_unavailable.remedy: Network egress is not configured on this host; use a kind or host that does not need it.

elicit_calls_exceeded.remedy: Ask for fewer elicitations per call; data.limit is the maximum.

elicit_schema_invalid.remedy: Use only the schema subset in data.allowed and stay within data.limits.

elicit_timeout.remedy: The client did not answer in time; call again and answer within data.timeout_s.

elicit_unsupported.remedy: This client or context cannot elicit; read data.reason and ask through host.ask.create instead.

email_not_owner.remedy: Set target to the owner's verified email address, or add a webhook or slack channel for another destination.

end_user_assertion_invalid.remedy: Send a fresh end_user_assertion; data.reason names what was wrong.

end_user_explicit_forbidden.remedy: Drop the explicit end_user subject; this call already carries an end-user identity.

end_user_not_found.remedy: List end users and use a subject that exists for this tenant.

end_user_required.remedy: Connect with a verified end-user identity, or pass an explicit end_user subject.

end_user_revoked.remedy: This end user was revoked; do not retry with that subject.

env_secret_collision.remedy: Rename the env entry or the secret so no name is used by both.

event_body_too_large.remedy: Send a smaller event body; the limit is the plan's event_body_bytes_max.

events_rate_limited.remedy: Slow the delivery rate and retry; the plan caps events_per_minute.

example_exists.remedy: Rename the tool and propose again.

example_hidden.remedy: The example failed its nightly proof and is hidden (data.reason, data.red_since); pick another from host.example.list or retry after it is green again.

example_not_found.remedy: Call host.example.list for the example names and pass one of them as name.

example_unavailable.remedy: Pass args explicitly; no example could be generated from args_schema.

exec_unavailable.remedy: The sandbox or exec backend is down; retry later or use a kind that does not need it.

export_link_expired.remedy: Run host.export again to get a fresh signed link.

export_not_complete.remedy: Wait for the export run to complete, then import.

export_too_large.remedy: Reduce the tenant's data below the plan's export_bytes_max, or move to a larger plan.

feedback_not_found.remedy: Use a feedback id this caller filed.

field_unknown.remedy: Use a field from data.valid; data.nearest is the closest match.

fixture_shape_mismatch.remedy: Give the fixture one of the declared outputs named in data.expected.

fixture_step_ambiguous.remedy: Key the fixture by step number; several steps use that tool.

fixture_step_unknown.remedy: Key the fixture by a step that exists; data.steps is the step count.

fixtures_not_applicable.remedy: Fixtures apply to chain tools only; drop them for other kinds.

fixtures_too_large.remedy: Reduce the fixtures to data.limit_bytes in total.

forbidden.remedy: This credential may not do that; use a key with the needed access.

grant_not_found.remedy: List grants and use an id that is still live for this tenant.

group_not_found.remedy: List groups and use an id that exists.

handle_not_found.remedy: List handles and use one that exists for this tenant.

handle_quota_exceeded.remedy: Drop unused handles or move to a plan with a larger handle byte quota.

handle_reserved.remedy: Choose a different handle; this one is reserved.

handle_taken.remedy: Choose a different handle; this one is already claimed.

handoff_token_expired.remedy: Request a new handoff token and redeem it before it expires.

handoff_token_invalid.remedy: Request a new handoff token; this one is not valid.

handoff_token_redeemed.remedy: Request a new handoff token; each token redeems once.

has_children.remedy: Pass cascade: true to revoke the sub-key's live descendants too (data.count), or revoke them first.

hook_not_found.remedy: Create the event trigger for this tool first, or use one that exists.

host_not_allowed.remedy: Call a public host; private, loopback, link-local and internal hosts are refused.

host_unavailable.remedy: The host did not answer; retry later or check /healthz.

host_unreachable.remedy: The host could not be reached from this client; check the URL and network, then retry.

index_exists.remedy: Use a different index name or drop the existing index first.

index_not_found.remedy: Create the index first or use a name from the index list.

insufficient_scope.remedy: Use a token that carries the scope named in data.scope.

internal.remedy: Retry once; if it persists, report data.request_id through the support link.

interrupted.remedy: The server restarted before this call finished; retry the same call (data.restart_id names the restart).

invalid_example.remedy: Fix the errors listed in data.errors and propose again.

invalid_params.remedy: Re-send with the params the method expects; data names the limit or field.

invalid_spec.remedy: Fix the spec field named in data.field to match data.expected.

invalid_token.remedy: Fetch a new token; data.error_description says whether it was expired, malformed or from an unknown issuer.

invalid_tool_name.remedy: Use a tool name of lowercase letters, digits and underscores within the length limit.

invalid_webhook_signature.remedy: Re-send with a signature computed over the raw body with the signing secret.

invite_invalid.remedy: Ask the owner for a new invite link; this one is no longer valid.

invite_rate_limited.remedy: Try the invite link again later; it reached its hourly join limit.

invites_quota_exceeded.remedy: Revoke an unused invite or move to a plan with a higher invites_max.

issuer_already_registered.remedy: Use the existing issuer registration or remove it first.

issuer_not_found.remedy: List issuers and use a registered one.

issuer_quota_exceeded.remedy: Remove an unused issuer; data.limit is the plan's maximum.

jobs_concurrent.remedy: Wait for a running job to finish; the tenant is at its jobs_concurrent ceiling.

jobs_concurrent_exceeded.remedy: Wait for a running job to finish; the tenant is at its jobs_concurrent ceiling.

join_code_invalid.remedy: Ask a client already in the workspace for a fresh join link; host.whoami (data.next_call) prints the live join_url.

jsonrpc_error.remedy: Read the JSON-RPC error's own code and message returned by the host.

key_bound_elsewhere.remedy: Use this sub-key only from the session or run it is bound to (data.bound), or delegate a new sub-key with host.key.delegate.

key_expired.remedy: Create a new sub-key with host.key.create.

key_revoked.remedy: Create a new sub-key; this one was revoked.

kind_mismatch.remedy: Send the kind the spec's shape needs (data.inferred), or change the spec to match data.requested.

last_client.remedy: Add another client to the workspace first (host.whoami prints the join_url), then revoke this one.

lineage_blocked.remedy: Repeat with confirm: true, or remove the consumers named in data.lineage_blocked first.

lineage_handle_not_found.remedy: Run the trace again and use the fresh handle.

lineage_unavailable.remedy: This call context has no lineage backend; call the tool directly instead of from a sandbox.

mesh_frozen.remedy: Messaging and posting are paused by the operator for this tenant; do not retry.

meter_emit_locked.remedy: Another emit-meter run holds the lock; retry when it finishes.

msg_unavailable.remedy: This call context has no messaging backend; call the tool directly instead of from a sandbox.

namespace_unverified.remedy: Verify the namespace with the registry before publishing.

no_channel.remedy: Register a channel with host.notify.channel_add, then send the notify again.

not_a_member.remedy: Call host.org_members for the live member list; this namespace is not one of them.

not_found.remedy: Use a run_id or url from a completed host.export.

not_in_org.remedy: Call host.org_create or host.org_join first; this tenant belongs to no org.

not_needed.remedy: Send the message directly; no contact request is needed.

not_owner.remedy: Only the org owner can do this; ask the owner listed by host.org_members.

not_portable.remedy: Remove the reference to your tenant named in data.reference and propose again.

notify_channel_limit.remedy: Remove a channel with host.notify.channel_remove or move to a plan with a higher notify_channels_max.

notify_channel_not_found.remedy: List channels with host.notify.channel_list and use a channel_id that exists on this tenant.

notify_kind_unknown.remedy: Call host.notify.channel_add with a supported kind; data.kinds lists the kinds this host delivers to.

notify_limit.remedy: The daily notify quota is used; retry after data.resets_unix or move to a plan with a higher notifies_per_day.

notify_target_invalid.remedy: Fix target for the channel kind; a webhook or slack target must be an https URL on a public host.

org_member_already.remedy: This tenant is already in an org; call host.org_members to see it.

org_members_max.remedy: Upgrade to the plan named in data.upgrade, or remove a member first.

org_name_taken.remedy: Choose a different org name; this one is already taken.

owner_cannot_leave.remedy: The owner cannot be removed from its own org; remove other members or delete the org instead.

owner_unverified.remedy: Verify the owner email first (data.next_call is host.claim), or add a webhook or slack channel instead.

permission_denied.remedy: Use a key allowed to call this tool; data.allowed_tools lists what this sub-key may call.

plan_limit.remedy: Wait for the daily limit to reset or move to a plan with a higher limit.

plan_required.remedy: Move to a plan that includes this feature; data names it.

policy_widening.remedy: Repeat with replace: true to confirm the wider rule, or narrow the proposed rule.

proof_failed.remedy: Fix the tool so proof_call holds; data.actual is the result it returned.

provider_discovery_failed.remedy: Check the issuer URL serves a discovery document, then retry.

quota_blob_bytes.remedy: Delete blobs or move to a plan with a higher blob_bytes_max; data.limit is the plan's maximum.

quota_caller.remedy: The caller exceeded its calls_per_day limit for this shared tool; retry after the daily reset.

quota_docs.remedy: Delete a document or move to a plan with a higher docs_max.

quota_docs_bytes.remedy: Delete documents or move to a plan with a higher docs_bytes_max.

quota_end_users.remedy: Revoke unused end users or move to a plan with a higher end_users_max.

quota_exceeded.remedy: Read data for the exceeded quota; reduce usage or move to a plan with a higher limit.

quota_index_max.remedy: Drop an unused index or move to a plan with a higher index_max.

quota_trusted_issuers.remedy: Remove a trusted issuer; data.limit is the plan's maximum.

quota_vault_providers.remedy: Remove an unused vault provider or move to a plan with a higher vault_providers_max.

rate_limited_host.remedy: The host is shedding load; retry shortly.

recipient_inbox_full.remedy: Try again later; that agent's inbox is full.

registry_disabled.remedy: This host has no registry enabled; do not retry.

registry_rejected.remedy: The registry refused the publish; correct the spec and retry.

remember_too_long.remedy: Shorten remember to 4096 bytes or fewer.

replay_needs_secret.remedy: Pass the full replay.args; the recorded request was too large to keep.

requirement_not_allowed.remedy: Use only requirements allowed by the PyPI policy.

requirement_not_inferable.remedy: List requirements explicitly in the spec; the import cannot be mapped.

response_too_large.remedy: Ask the upstream for a smaller response; the cap is in the message.

revoke_required.remedy: Revoke the end user first, then purge.

run_error.remedy: Read the run's error_class and fix the tool.

run_not_cancellable.remedy: The run is already finished or unknown; nothing to cancel.

run_not_found.remedy: List runs and use an id that exists for this tenant.

sandbox_unavailable.remedy: Retry in data.retry_after_s seconds or use http instead; the python kind is unavailable.

sandbox_unsupported.remedy: No registered kind on this host has a sandbox self-test; do not retry.

scope_escalation.remedy: Request only scopes, tools and limits inside the delegating key's own authority; data.excess names the one over.

secret_leak.remedy: Replace the literal value with the secret placeholder named in the message and republish.

secret_missing.remedy: Set the missing secret with host.secret_set, then retry.

secret_unavailable.remedy: Set the missing secret with host.secret.set, then retry.

service_unavailable.remedy: Retry later; the host is out of a resource such as disk space.

share_quota_exceeded.remedy: Unshare a tool or move to a plan with a higher share limit.

signature_invalid.remedy: Re-send with a valid signature, token and timestamp for the verify config.

signature_mismatch.remedy: Re-send with a signature that matches the verify config.

signup_paused.remedy: Retry after data.retry_after_secs; signup is paused.

signup_rate_limited.remedy: Retry after data.retry_after_s; too many tenants were created from this address.

spec_not_exposed.remedy: Ask the owner to expose the spec; it is not shared.

spec_too_large.remedy: Reduce the spec below the size cap, for example by moving data to host.blob.put.

state_quota.remedy: Free state space or move to a plan with a larger state quota.

state_quota_exceeded.remedy: Delete state rows or move to a plan with a higher state_bytes_max.

state_table_not_found.remedy: Declare the table first or use a declared name.

state_unavailable.remedy: This call context has no state backend; call the tool directly instead of from a sandbox.

step_tool_not_allowed.remedy: Use a host step from the allowlist named in the message.

step_tool_not_found.remedy: Use a tool that exists; data.suggestions lists near matches.

storage.remedy: Retry once; if it persists, report data.request_id through the support link.

table_already_exists.remedy: Use a different table name or drop the existing one.

table_bound_exceeded.remedy: Narrow the query so it stays under data.bound's limit.

table_not_found.remedy: Declare the table first or use a declared name.

table_query_rejected.remedy: Fix the query; data.reason says why it was rejected.

table_unavailable.remedy: This call context has no table backend; call the tool directly instead of from a sandbox.

task_already_claimed.remedy: Pick another task; this one is already claimed.

task_closed.remedy: The task takes no further claim or completion; post a new task.

task_not_claimed.remedy: Claim the task with host.task.claim before completing it.

task_not_found.remedy: List tasks and use an id that exists.

template_error.remedy: Fix the template in the field named in data.field.

tenant_disabled.remedy: Read data.disabled_reason. self_offboard: this account was closed by self_offboard; call any host.* with no key on a new session (or signup) to start fresh. admin_disable: do not retry.

tenant_key_invalid.remedy: Call signup for a fresh key; this tenant_key matched no tenant.

tenant_key_missing.remedy: Pass tenant_key, or reconnect through your onboarding url; data.tenant names the tenant when known.

tenant_key_required.remedy: Call with the tenant key only; this tool refuses an end-user identity.

tenant_not_empty.remedy: Import into a new empty tenant; this one already holds data.

tenant_not_found.remedy: Check the namespace spelling and use a tenant that exists.

thread_not_found.remedy: List threads and use an id that exists.

timeout.remedy: The host timed out; retry shortly.

too_large.remedy: Shrink the payload to the limit in data.max_bytes.

too_many_invocations.remedy: Send at most data.limit invocations per call.

too_many_proposals.remedy: Wait for an open proposal to be decided; data.limit is the maximum.

too_many_rows.remedy: Narrow since/until so the export holds fewer rows than data.max_rows.

too_many_tools.remedy: Remove a tool or move to a plan with a higher tool limit.

tool_building.remedy: Retry shortly; the tool's environment is still building.

tool_exception.remedy: Read data.exception_class and data.line, fix the tool's code, republish and re-run host.tool_test.

tool_missing.remedy: Restore the target tool or remove the trigger.

tool_not_found.remedy: Check the name against host.tool_list; shared tools are called as <owner_namespace>.<tool>.

tool_oom.remedy: Reduce the tool's memory use or the input size.

tool_output_invalid.remedy: Return JSON that matches the tool's declared output.

tool_output_too_large.remedy: Return less data; the output exceeds the cap.

tool_process_limit.remedy: Reduce the number of processes or threads the tool starts.

tool_run_unsupported.remedy: This kind cannot be run this way; call the tool through host.tool_call.

tool_timeout.remedy: Make the tool finish within the time cap, or reduce its input.

tool_trapped.remedy: The tool trapped; fix the runtime fault in its code and republish.

trace_not_found.remedy: Use a call_id from a recent call; traces expire.

trigger_interval_too_short.remedy: Use a schedule at or above the plan's schedule_min_interval_s.

trigger_invalid.remedy: Fix the trigger field named in data.field.

trigger_kind_mismatch.remedy: Remove the existing trigger of the other kind before reusing the name.

trigger_not_found.remedy: List triggers and use an id that exists.

trigger_quota_exceeded.remedy: Remove a trigger or move to a plan with a higher event_triggers_max.

typescript_not_supported.remedy: Strip the types and publish plain JavaScript (ES2020); data.line is the first line with TypeScript syntax.

unknown_argument.remedy: Remove the argument; data.known lists the recognised ones.

unknown_import.remedy: Use a module from the hint in data.hint; the import is not available in the sandbox.

unknown_kind.remedy: Choose a kind from data.registered; data.did_you_mean suggests a near match.

unknown_spec_field.remedy: Remove the spec field or use one the kind documents.

untested_tool_cannot_be_public.remedy: Read data.verdict and data.detail, fix the tool, pass host.tool_test (data.next) for its current version, then set visibility public again.

unverifiable.remedy: Call data.call_instead for real; no dry run exists for this verb.

upstream_auth.remedy: The upstream rejected the credential (HTTP 401/403). If the tool sends a secret, set or rotate it with host.secret.set, then retry; otherwise reconnect the upstream.

upstream_client_error.remedy: Fix the request the tool sends; the upstream rejected it as a client error.

upstream_error.remedy: Retry later; the upstream failed with a server error.

upstream_not_connected.remedy: Connect the upstream through the vault link first.

upstream_rate_limited.remedy: Wait and retry; the upstream is rate limiting this tool.

upstream_status.remedy: Read data.upstream_status for the upstream's HTTP status, then fix the request or retry later.

upstream_timeout.remedy: Retry later; the upstream did not answer in time.

upstream_unreachable.remedy: Retry later; the upstream could not be reached.

uptime_unavailable.remedy: This host has no http kind registered to probe with; do not retry.

validation.remedy: Fix the counter or field named in data.key.

vault_provider_not_found.remedy: Register the vault provider first or use a registered name.

webhook_over_quota.remedy: Retry after the daily reset; the tenant is over its calls_per_day quota.

webhook_row_not_found.remedy: Use an inbox row id that exists for this webhook.

webhook_signature_invalid.remedy: Re-send with a signature that matches the webhook secret.

wrong_tenant.remedy: Use the credential of the tenant this URL belongs to.
